headline: Yi-Chia Chen closes ARC-3 gap to Tufa Labs to 0.70

sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen gained 0.44 points to reach 68.21, holding 2nd on ARC-AGI-3. Tufa Labs leads at 68.91, unchanged.
The 0.70-point margin keeps the top two close, with Tufa Labs having led since October 13.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
